motivation: Neurons chosen by correlation with success mark it but are not levers; the author asked for the neurons responsible for better performance, which needs an interventional search.
hypothesis: Neurons chosen on half the tasks by their attributed effect on 31B's preference for a passing run's edit over its own failing edit, when actually scaled, raise that preference in at least 65% of held-out pairs and more than random neurons do.
